newsitem.title: HONDURAS: Central America electricity needs growing - study.
newsitem.headline: Central America electricity needs growing - study.

text.p: Central American nations need to invest at least $1 billion a year to avoid future electricity shortages, a study showed on Wednesday.

"It is necessary to invest a significant amount of money in order to meet the growing demand for electricity in the region," said a joint study released by the United Nations' Latin American Economic Commission (CEPAL) and the Central American Bank for Integration.
The study said modernization of Central America's energy sector is one of the most important steps in the development of the region.
Central America's energy ministers were due to meet on Wednesday in Guatemala to discuss regional energy plans and a scheme to link up the seven country's electricity systems.
